entries.summary: Split operator presentation, policy-guard, and daemon command handling out of main.rs.
entries.reason: main.rs is carrying parsing, policy, reporting, and live runtime composition in one file, which increases drift risk.

entries.summary: Factor /core projection writers into smaller modules with shared helpers.
entries.reason: core_link.rs now owns startup reconciliation plus many projection writers, which makes future subsystem additions brittle.

entries.summary: Extract a shared persisted-runtime contract for status path, schema tagging, and snapshot persistence.
entries.reason: The new service layers follow the same file-backed runtime pattern and can share helpers without hard-coupling subsystem logic.

entries.summary: Reduce hades log and backup growth with stronger compaction/rotation defaults.
entries.reason: Pressure guard history already shows oversize-file alerts centered on HADES logs.

entries.summary: Review whether the ceo compatibility shim should stay as-is or fold into a cleaner package boundary.
entries.reason: The shim is intentional today, but it should be kept explicit so it does not become accidental duplication.

entries.summary: Unify governance metadata builders across exposed transport crates.
entries.reason: COMM and MCP now both emit symbolic/governance metadata and would benefit from one shared contract.
